title: Nonogram Atelier
coreMechanic: 1) Pick a puzzle from an island or the daily. 2) Solve with tap, hold or drag using clue logic and auto-X. 3) The picture reveals in ink or color with a satisfying completion animation. 4) Earn Pigments (soft currency) and a framed artwork. 5) Spend Pigments and finished art to renovate rooms of the atelier, which unlocks the next story beat and cosmetics. 6) A daily puzzle and a forgiving streak bring the player back tomorrow. Next puzzle is one tap and never blocked.
